title: Kaba Aye Pagoda
geometryBasis: The named mapped grounds, approximate published 34 metre core diameter, 112 foot height, original exterior photo and native elevation field.
sectionBasis: A gilt 34.14 metre bell and spire on a white circular prayer hall with gold crenellations, repeated scalloped pointed arches and five red and gold pointed porches.
limitations: The model represents the March 2015 exterior of the central Kaba Aye Pagoda. The surrounding grounds and separately named cave are outside scope.
The photograph fixes the cladding, bell curve, trim and one porch. Other porches, exact gateway axes, relief details and ground registration are approximate.
